wins: Affinity: flood the board with 0–1 mana artifacts, launch Drone fighters with Pinnacle Emissary, and attack with an unblockable, ever-growing Kappa Cannoneer.
plan: Mox Opal, Mishra’s Bauble, Tormod’s Crypt, Engineered Explosives. Warp in Pinnacle Emissary for 1 mana on a turn you’ll cast several artifacts.
Improvise out Kappa Cannoneer (tap artifacts to pay). Weapons Manufacturing turns every artifact into a Munitions token.
Drones peck in the air, Cannoneer grows +1/+1 and can’t be blocked each time an artifact enters, Munitions fire 2 damage each when sacrificed.
keys: A 1/1 flying Drone for every artifact spell. Warp it for 1, recast it later for keeps.
Ward 4 and unblockable whenever an artifact enters.
Recasts an artifact from your graveyard each turn (Mishra’s Bauble is a free loop).
Turns an artifact into a 2/2 flyer each combat at 2 charge counters.
tips: Sacrifice Munitions tokens first to Arcbound Ravager or Claws of Gix: each one deals 2 damage.
Against artifact hate (Force of Vigor, Shatterstorm), hold a couple of artifacts back.
Sink into Stupor can be played as a land when you need one.
mulligan: Keep 1–2 lands with plenty of cheap artifacts and a payoff (Emissary, Cannoneer or Weapons Manufacturing).
sideboard: Whipflare (hits only nonartifact creatures), Galvanic Blast
